sentences.en: People do not enjoy being confronted with their mortality.
sentences.zh: 人们不喜欢面对自己的死亡。

sentences.en: Above the moon, everything is eternal; below, there is nothing save mortality.
sentences.zh: 在月亮之上，一切都是永恒的；而在下面，则只有死亡。

sentences.en: Chad has the world's third-highest maternal mortality rate.
sentences.zh: 乍得的孕产妇死亡率是世界上第三高的。

senses.zh: 死亡数，死亡率；必死性，必死的命运
